days.title: Central Lake and Northern Slopes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Neusiedler See
stops.detail: The center of the cultural landscape is Lake Neusiedl, with its lakeshore landscapes typical of a steppe lake, such as the wide reed belts.

stops.name: Leithagebirge
stops.detail: The cultural landscape also includes the numerous vineyards that have developed on the slopes of the Leitha Mountains down to the lakeshore due to the Pannonian climate, making Burgenland a well-known wine region.

stops.name: Sulfina
